Alex (eng-runtime): Heads up — canary mgr4 showed rising RSS on smallalloc-heavy runs after the quantization change. Reprobed with local benchmark, looks like steady ~200MB climb over 10k inferences. Anyone on call?
Maria G: hmm, can you paste the canary logs? Did we roll the allocator patch yesterday?
SRE Bot: [ALERT] canary-mgr4: rss > 75% threshold at 11:12 UTC — created incident INC-7892
Alex (eng-runtime): putting snippet: 
```
2026-03-16T11:12:05Z INFO rss=1.9G vsize=2.1G smallalloc_count=1.2M
2026-03-16T11:12:15Z INFO rss=2.1G vsize=2.3G smallalloc_count=1.3M
```
Alex (eng-runtime): running `bench_smallalloc --profile kv-cache --iters 10000` shows gradual RSS climb.
Vikram P: Could be the prefix KV cache not evicting due to the new cache-key hashing change. Can you run heapshot and grep for slab stats?
Alex (eng-runtime): yeah running now, will upload snapshot to /tmp/heapshot-2071122334.tar.gz
Maria G: pinging @rachel to see if allocator PR #4122 included the compacting flag.
Rachel L: I reviewed #4122 — didn't touch the slab evictor, but did add a zap-on-free in debug builds. Not sure that affects release.
Vikram P: also try `MALLOC_CONF=oversize_threshold:1` or run with `--allocorchestrator=compact` to test behavior.
Alex (eng-runtime): quick heapshot extract: 
```
slab_total: 256MB
slab_free: 24MB
slab_alloc: 232MB
hot_pages: 48
fragmentation_ratio: 1.12
```
Alex (eng-runtime): hypothesis: quant canary increases short-lived small allocations, allocator isn't coalescing leading to higher RSS. Want a targeted benchmark that toggles `compact` with/without prefix cache.
Maria G: I'll spin a canary with compact on and with prefix cache disabled, need ~2 hrs. Anyone want the test matrix?
Vikram P: I'll add a micro-bench script and share the cfg. Keeping sequence length / batch same, and reproducing the exact request footprint.
Rachel L: FYI leaving note on PR to add a quick flag to enable compact mode at runtime for canaries.
Alex (eng-runtime): ty. If we see >150MB delta between runs we'll open a regression and bisect against recent merges. For now, moving to async — add results to INC-7892 and drop heapshots in the incident attachments.
SRE Bot: incident INC-7892 updated by Alex (eng-runtime)
